draw_algorithm: for b in range(n_boot): for d in sorted(strata): idx = rng.integers(0, n_groups[d], size=n_groups[d], dtype=int64); replicate rows = concat of member rows of sampled groups (with replacement, groups may repeat)
bootstrap_selection_rule: within each replicate, re-apply the frozen policy ranking (routing_score DESC, sample_id ASC over the canonical sample_id-ascending order) to the resampled eligible multiset and select the top K_b_rep = n_elig_rep if budget==1.00 else floor(budget*n_elig_rep); the budget is treated as a fraction of the replicate eligible count
oracle_in_replicate: top K_b_rep of the replicate eligible multiset by true DeltaDice DESC, sample_id ASC, with K_b_rep as defined by bootstrap_selection_rule
size_strata_definition: quartiles of the GT-free predicted_roi_area_fraction over the 4957 eligible DEV rows (Q25/Q50/Q75 frozen); strata Q1..Q4 lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive; a GT-free deployment-available proxy distinct from the historical GT tiny taxonomy
paired_two_sided_p: p_lower=(1+count(D_b<=0))/(B+1); p_upper=(1+count(D_b>=0))/(B+1); p=min(1, 2*min(p_lower,p_upper)); D_b = metric_A(b) - metric_B(b)
multiplicity: primary = raw paired two-sided p; secondary = Holm-Bonferroni within the pre-declared C7-vs-comparator family (C1..C6, C10)

metrics.benefit_capture_at_budget: sum(max(d_i,0) for i in S) / sum(max(d_i,0) for i in E)
metrics.mean_true_delta_dice_among_routed: sum(d_i for i in S) / K
metrics.routing_regret_vs_oracle: sum(d_i for i in oracle top-K) - sum(d_i for i in S)
metrics.macro_domain_mean_true_delta_dice: mean over domains of mean(d_i for i in S intersect domain)

zero_denominator: null with reason UNDEFINED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR; sums over empty sets are zero
